Read a table from any hypernets object

Source: R/accessors.R
hg_get.Rd

hg_get() is the single reader of the package. Every object a constructor or a verb returns – a hypergraph, a memory network, a simplicial complex, an inference or a community result – hands over its tables through hg_get(), never through $. what = selects the table; what = NULL (the default) returns the object's primary table. Filters, orderings and top = are named arguments of the method for that class.

Usage

hg_get(x, what = NULL, ...)

# Default S3 method
hg_get(x, what = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A hypernets object.

what

NULL (default) for the object's primary table, or the name of one of its tables (see Tables by class).

...

Arguments of the method for class(x): filters (order_min, min_count, dim, k, dimension, significant, ...), sort_by, and top (the first top rows, applied last).

Value

A base data.frame, one row per observation of the selected table. An object of a class without a method raises hypernets_bad_input, naming the class.

Tables by class

net_hg (hypergraphs)

"edges" (default), "nodes", "memberships", "sets", "state_counts", "node_data", "edge_data", "incidence_data"; see hg_get.net_hg().

text_hypergraph

"weights" (default), "documents", "vocabulary", "sentences"; see hg_get.text_hypergraph().

net_temporal_hypergraph

"memberships" (default), "edges", "nodes".

net_hon (hon())

"rules" (default), "nodes", "pathways".

net_honem (honem())

"embeddings" (default), "variance".

net_hypa (hypa() on sequences)

"scores" (default), "over", "under", "pathways".

net_mogen (mogen())

"orders" (default), "transitions", "paths", "pathways".

net_markov_order (markov_order())

"orders" (default), "null".

net_path_dependence (memory())

"contexts".

net_markov_stability (hg_markov_stability())

"states" (default), "passage_time", "stationary".

net_hon_boot (hg_bootstrap())

"edges".

net_hon_compare (hg_compare())

"edges".

net_hon_communities (hg_communities() on a memory network)

"states" (default), "physical", "modules", "codelength", "trials".

simplicial_complex (simplicial())

"simplices" (default), "f_vector", "degree".

q_analysis (hg_qanalysis())

"q_levels" (default), "nodes".

persistent_homology (hg_homology())

"persistence" (default), "betti".

persistence_landscape (hg_landscape())

"landscape".

hg_communities (hg_communities() on a hypergraph)

see hg_get.hg_communities().

hypernets_community_comparison, hypernets_motifs, net_hg_mmsbm

see their methods.

Examples

hg <- window_hypergraph(list(s1 = c("a", "b", "a", "c")), window = 2L)
hg_get(hg)
#>   hyperedge size members weight
#> 1        h1    2    a, b      2
#> 2        h2    2    a, c      1
hg_get(hg, what = "nodes")
#>   node degree
#> 1    a      2
#> 2    b      1
#> 3    c      1

seqs <- list(c("a", "b", "c", "a", "b", "c"), c("x", "b", "d", "x", "b", "d"))
hg_get(hon(seqs, max_order = 2), what = "nodes")
#>   id node
#> 1  1    a
#> 2  2    b
#> 3  3    c
#> 4  4    d
#> 5  5    x
